name: Rate-Cut Sensitive
rationale: Leans into equities when yields and policy rates are falling (easing) and de-risks when rate momentum turns up; custom 21-day cadence tracks macro releases.

rebalance_triggers.action: Step equity allocation down one regime level

rebalance_triggers.condition: Fed funds falling for 2 consecutive prints

risk_notes: Rate signal is one input to the regime score; inflation shocks can override easing.
